use default
use Raster.IMAGE

let columns = 24
let rows = 16
let cell = 22
let margin = 5

let random = System.Random(20260918)

let visited = LIST[bool]()
let right_open = LIST[bool]()
let down_open = LIST[bool]()

for _ in 0..columns * rows do
    visited.add(false)
    right_open.add(false)
    down_open.add(false)
od

at(column: int, row: int) -> int => row * columns + column

inside(column: int, row: int) -> bool =>
    column >= 0 /\ column < columns /\ row >= 0 /\ row < rows

let directions =
    [(across = 1, down = 0), (across = -1, down = 0),
     (across = 0, down = 1), (across = 0, down = -1)]

shuffled() -> Collections.List[(across: int, down: int)] is
    let order = LIST(directions)
    let index mut = order.count - 1

    while index > 0 do
        let other = random.next(index + 1)
        let held = order[index]

        order[index] = order[other]
        order[other] = held
        index = index - 1
    od

    return order
si

carve(column: int, row: int) is
    visited[at(column, row)] = true

    for step in shuffled() do
        let next_column = column + step.across
        let next_row = row + step.down

        if inside(next_column, next_row) /\
                !visited[at(next_column, next_row)] then
            if step.across == 1 then
                right_open[at(column, row)] = true
            elif step.across == -1 then
                right_open[at(next_column, row)] = true
            elif step.down == 1 then
                down_open[at(column, row)] = true
            else
                down_open[at(column, next_row)] = true
            fi

            carve(next_column, next_row)
        fi
    od
si

carve(random.next(columns), random.next(rows))

let image =
    IMAGE(columns * cell + 2 * margin, rows * cell + 2 * margin)

wall(from_x: int, from_y: int, to_x: int, to_y: int) is
    image.line(
        cast double(margin + from_x * cell),
        cast double(margin + from_y * cell),
        cast double(margin + to_x * cell),
        cast double(margin + to_y * cell)
    )
si

image.colour(30ub, 40ub, 90ub)
image.stroke(2.4D)

wall(0, 0, columns, 0)
wall(0, rows, columns, rows)
wall(0, 0, 0, rows)
wall(columns, 0, columns, rows)

for row in 0..rows do
    for column in 0..columns do
        if column < columns - 1 /\
                !right_open[at(column, row)] then
            wall(column + 1, row, column + 1, row + 1)
        fi

        if row < rows - 1 /\ !down_open[at(column, row)] then
            wall(column, row + 1, column + 1, row + 1)
        fi
    od
od

open(from: int, to: int) -> bool =>
    if to == from + 1 then right_open[from]
    elif to == from - 1 then right_open[to]
    elif to == from + columns then down_open[from]
    else down_open[to]
    fi

neighbours(i: int) -> Pipe[int] =>
    directions
        |> map(d =>
            (column = i % columns + d.across, row = i / columns + d.down))
        |> filter(c => inside(c.column, c.row))
        |> map(c => at(c.column, c.row))
        |> filter(next => open(i, next))

shortest_path(start: int, finish: int) -> List[int] is
    let previous = MAP[int, int]()
    let queue = Collections.Queue[int]()

    queue.enqueue(start)
    previous[start] = start

    while queue.count > 0 do
        let here = queue.dequeue()

        for next in neighbours(here) do
            if !previous.contains_key(next) then
                previous[next] = here
                queue.enqueue(next)
            fi
        od
    od

    let path = LIST[int]([finish])

    while path[0] != start do
        path.insert(0, previous[path[0]])
    od

    path
si

let path = shortest_path(at(0, 0), at(columns - 1, rows - 1))

write_line("{path.count} cells from the top left to the bottom right")

centre(i: int) -> (x: double, y: double) =>
    (
        x = cast double(margin + (i % columns) * cell + cell / 2),
        y = cast double(margin + (i / columns) * cell + cell / 2))

image.colour(210ub, 50ub, 40ub)
image.stroke(4.0D)
image.line(path |> map(centre) |> collect_list())

image.write("solved.png")

image.show("solved.png")
